purpose: Fix where the data comes from, what the app may touch, and what it may never do on its own, per kind.

questions.question: What information does it work with, and where does that live?
Does any of it name a real borrower, account or loan number?
Which folder may this chat read and write?
Anything it must never do on its own: run commands, install things, send messages?

artifact: the Backend row of APP.md; one optional file, data-policy.json, only when a chat calls a panel API

rules.rule: A page has no network. fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, sendBeacon, dynamic import(), <script src>, <link href> and @import all fail silently.
rules.sutra_source: modules_api.py PAGE_CSP; static/js/18-modules.js sandbox=allow-scripts; APPS-THREATS.md information disclosure
rules.enforced_by: CSP and iframe sandbox block it silently; C25 turns the silence into a named failure

rules.rule: A page's data lives inline in index.html. assets/** is a package member but no route serves it, so a relative reference is a dead image at runtime.
rules.sutra_source: modules_api.py page_html; modules_pkg.py whitelist; APPS-THREATS.md X-3
rules.enforced_by: C26 prints the specific assets message; standing gap, flagged not papered over

rules.rule: Images and fonts come from data: or blob: only.
Only a chat can reach a panel API, and every call needs an entry in data-policy.json carrying the call, why, a threat note and a check id. A page's allowlist is empty by construction.
rules.enforced_by: C26 for the page arm; C38 for the chat arm

rules.rule: A chat's instructions are the visible first message. No key, password, token or account number goes in them.
surface.cwd is absolute, under $HOME, at most 1024 characters. Outside $HOME the server silently substitutes the default workdir.
rules.sutra_source: modules_api.py create_module cwd; providers.py workdir confinement
rules.enforced_by: C29, which fails loudly where the server falls back silently

rules.rule: Instructions must not order a command the owner did not write down. Whatever the chat may run is listed verbatim in the Backend row's Owner notes.
rules.enforced_by: C30, over a fixed verb list only

rules.rule: A link's target is a live screen id, never terminal or usage, never a URL, and surface carries nothing else (user-created links; system seeds keep their shape).
rules.sutra_source: modules_api.py SCREEN_RE, LINK_FORBIDDEN, create_module; static/js/01-state.js DEST_PLANES
rules.enforced_by: C32; create_module refuses extra surface keys on user links

rules.rule: Nothing leaves the machine. Export and import stay off until the owner switches them on, and an export writes a local file.
rules.enforced_by: server flag gate; stated once in the Backend row, no check id of its own

rules.rule: Before an app is handed to someone else, the record declares the data as one of: real, masked, made-up, aggregate.
rules.enforced_by: C31, an enum match on the B2 cell

checks.what: No network call anywhere in the page.
checks.evaluator: regex over index.html and any .js/.htm in the folder: fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, new WebSocket, EventSource, navigator.sendBeacon, import(, importScripts, <script src=, <link href=, @import, <form, target=_top/_parent, window.top; any hit FAILs with file and line

checks.what: Everything the page references is inline: data:, blob: or a # anchor.
checks.evaluator: HTMLParser collects src, href, srcset, poster, action plus CSS url() and @font-face src; any other scheme or a bare relative path FAILs; assets/ gets the 'no route serves it' message; /api/ gets 'a page cannot reach the panel'

checks.what: The B1 answer does not assume reach the page does not have.
checks.evaluator: keyword scan of the B1 cell: fetch|http|api call|endpoint|database|localstorage|saves? (it|them|the data)|uploads?|reads? my .*\.(csv|json|xlsx); a hit FAILs and names the page's real reach; the documented waiver case

checks.what: No secret anywhere in the app folder.
checks.evaluator: pattern over module.json, index.html, APP.md, data-policy.json and assets text files: sk-, ghp_, github_pat_, AKIA, xox[baprs]-, AIza, BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, (api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)\s*[:=]\s*quoted 12+ chars; values masked to the last four characters

checks.what: The chat's folder is real, absolute and under $HOME.
checks.evaluator: surface.cwd absent PASSes; present must be a string <= 1024 chars, absolute, realpath under expanduser('~'), and the directory must exist; FAIL quotes what the server would silently substitute

checks.what: Every command on the watched verb list that the instructions mention is one the owner wrote down.
checks.evaluator: scan surface.instructions for curl , wget , | sh, bash -c, npm install, pip install, rm -rf, git push, ssh , open -a, osascript, launchctl; each hit must have the same verb in the Backend row's Owner notes

checks.what: The B2 cell declares the data as one of a fixed set.
checks.evaluator: the cell's first word, lowercased, is in {real, masked, made-up, aggregate}; kind-required once P7 names someone else

checks.what: The link opens a live screen and its surface carries nothing else.
checks.evaluator: surface.screen matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40}$, is in screens.json (generated from SCREEN_IDS), not terminal or usage; surface has exactly the one key screen; folder holds no index.html and no assets/; user-created links only

checks.what: data-policy.json matches its schema when a panel API is called, and is absent when none is.
checks.evaluator: when surface.instructions or the Backend row names a /api/ call the file must exist, parse and validate against data-policy.schema.json (each panel_apis entry carries call, why, threat, check_id in this kit); when no panel call is named the file must be absent; present with empty panel_apis FAILs 'delete this file, nothing calls the panel'
